description: Planogram definitions exported inside project ZIPs and reused when building retail-layout exports.

notes: rotation is constrained to 0, 90, 180 or 270 degrees.

aiHints: Planogram cells reference products only by EAN; no product metadata is duplicated here.
When gondola is present, it is the richer boundary-based source of truth for that planogram.
retail-layout.json is a denormalized derivative built from scene.json plus planograms.json; its furniture[].placements[] objects are not raw planogram records.
